data_description.name: Display name — used to generate the stable zone ID
data_description.head_entity: The climate entity controlling this zone's heat pump head
data_description.sensor_entity: The sensor reporting actual room temperature
data_description.weekday_blocks: Time blocks for Monday–Friday. Add as many as needed.
data_description.weekend_blocks: Time blocks for Saturday–Sunday. Add as many as needed.

data_description.update_interval_minutes: How often the decision loop runs
data_description.override_duration_minutes: How long a manual temperature override lasts
data_description.setpoint_tolerance_c: Minimum change before commanding the heat pump
data_description.offset_clamp_c: Maximum offset the ML model can apply
data_description.force_cool_threshold_c: Override all zones to cool above this outdoor temperature
data_description.force_cool_clear_c: Release force-cool once outdoor temperature drops below this
data_description.hallway_sensor: Used as a whole-house reference temperature
